newyear.name: New Year rhythm
newyear.description: A New Year rhythm game on a matrix of the show: notes fall to the beat, up to 4 phones tap them in time
newyear.intro: 🎆 New Year: a rhythm game on a matrix of the show. Notes fall down 4 lanes in the New Year colours to the beat of a song the app makes itself, and up to 4 phones tap the matching pad when a note reaches the line. Perfect timing is 3 points, good 1, and a long run of notes in a row earns more. Alone, or friends join within a few seconds. The words at the end can say "Happy New Year!" ({greeting}). Pick the matrix, then Save.
